summary: Initial US-listed equity universe for the broad AI theme, organized as a first-pass map across demand, infrastructure, semiconductors, networking, power, and software. This is a Layer 1 theme funnel pass: it prioritizes breadth and chain coverage over final ranking. No buy/sell views are implied.
universe_method: Seeded from the provided pilot universe, then normalized into a broad AI value-chain map with emphasis on US-listed equities and companies above roughly USD 1B market cap when known. Coverage spans hyperscaler demand, AI software, AI accelerators, foundry/packaging, networking, power/cooling, grid/electric equipment, and nuclear/power-fuel adjacencies. Candidates were selected to represent major nodes in the AI cloud/data-center/semiconductor system rather than a single ticker or one narrow subtheme.
